posts.title: Code is cheap. Show me the talk.
posts.description: TLDR; Software development, as it has been done for decades, is over. LLM coding tools have changed it fundamentally for the better or worse. “Talk is cheap. Show me the code.” — Linus Torvalds, August 2000

posts.title: MCP seems viral
posts.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) [1] is all the rage now.
